# Davy Keith

## Overview

- **Age:** 10 years old  <sub>[v3 c28 P4](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0004)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v2 c8 P10](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0010)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v3 c5 P17](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0017)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Davy-boy  <sub>[v3 c22 P23](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0023)</sub>

## Appearance

Davy is a fair and handsome lad with a crop of fuzzy little yellow ringlets all over his round head. He has roguish hazel eyes, a snub nose, and a smile with a dimple in one cheek, giving him a dear, comical, lopsided look when he laughs.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c8 P33](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0033)_

## Personality

Davy is energetic, inquisitive, full of lively curiosity, and often heedless or mischievous. He is practical and completely lacking in imagination, often puzzled by fanciful ideas. Possessing a natural knack for winning love, he is easily comforted by food and can be easily led into submission through affection.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c14 P30](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0030), [v2 c16 P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 c18 P3](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0003), [v2 c24 P10](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0010), [v2 c25 P41](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0041)_

## Goals

- To become a storekeeper like Mr. Blair  <sub>[v2 c14 P31](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0031)</sub>
- To live to be a hundred years old  <sub>[v3 c14 P43](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0043)</sub>
- To see stone gods at the lighthouse

## History

Davy and his twin sister Dora were orphaned after their mother died, having lost their father as an infant. Marilla Cuthbert took them into Green Gables, where Davy quickly earned a reputation for mischief and endless questions. Anne Shirley took a maternal interest in him, successfully using patience and affection to encourage him to be good. Davy began attending Avonlea school alongside his desk mate Milty Boulter and competed over height with him. As he grew older, he was considered a smart boy who settled into better habits, though he retained a love for violent stories and a strong political interest as a Conservative.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c8 P33](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0033), [v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v3 c18 P23](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0023), [v3 c40 P6](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0006), [v4 c4 P7](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0007), [v4 c9 P27](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0027)_
